summary: Thanking the other side's leader: {other-party leader} helps {the place} after {the disaster}, and the cameras catch you thanking them days before {party}'s big race.
realLife: One life: Days before the 2012 presidential vote he praised President Obama's storm relief. Conservatives said he hurt his party's nominee, and his approval at home peaked. Another: Nine days after the September 11 attacks he hugged President Bush on the Senate floor. When he used the footage in a 2004 ad, the Republican National Committee demanded it be pulled.
